test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is M related to Q if ‘M ÷ N + O − P × Q’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: M ÷ N + O − P × Q

M ÷ N → M is the father of N.

N + O → N is the sister of O.

O − P → O is the brother of P.

P × Q → P is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68ac5fdc05556657b38ac28812add91d9019768db723868ec1e2aa638435a550.png] 

Thus, M is Q's wife's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
